title: Jacob: dependence measures beyond covariance (Sobol, mutual information) for LLM-agent / simulator / world-model benchmarking - env luck in GRPO gradients, reward hacking vs reward infidelity
abstract: Is linear dependence (covariance) sufficient for the dependencies that matter in agent/simulator benchmarking? Examples: environment luck on GRPO gradients; reward hacking under reward infidelity. Operator: the recipe half (paired rollouts / CRN in GRPO) is occupied as of Sept-Oct 2026; the luck table across environments captured as CL-W44-J01; EVT tail competition imported onto CL-W43-J04; the unifying principle: dependence measured where the optimizer will take you (tail), not where the data is (covariance).
triage_reason: chat capture: CL-W44-J01; import onto CL-W43-J04

title: Jacob: can GRAFT (gradient routing localises and removes unintended behaviours in RL, 2610.17062) inform the robotics / simulator RL thread?
